title: GSE Windows Agent

prerequisites.name: Windows PowerShell 5.1
prerequisites.note: Included with the supported Windows versions. The agent reads the process list and starts games through it (CIM). wmic is no longer used.

prerequisites.name: Administrator rights to install
prerequisites.note: The installer requires an elevated session and creates the local agent account (default: gameserver).

prerequisites.name: Cygwin runtime
prerequisites.note: Bundled with the agent. Nothing to install.

prerequisites.name: DirectX End-User Runtime (June 2010)
prerequisites.note: Bundled installer, for game servers that need the older DirectX files.

unverified: The minimum versions come from the PowerShell 5.1 and CIM requirement. Only Windows Server 2022 has been tested.
